title: Northgate Store and Online Orders — The Credited Haul-Away Where Several Items Were Settled
content:
**The credited haul-away.** For the replacement haul-away credit of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, two counts are taken:

- the old items booked, being the haul-away charge before benefits divided by the program's haul-away fee per item, which is 25.00 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery;
- the customer's settlements by replacement or reimbursement of items of the settled category dated the same day as the settlement read (the customer's most recent claim settlement on the records of Northgate Protect Protection Plans (administered by Keystone Protection Services)), the day that claim decision was settled.

| Such settlements | Old items booked | Credited haul-away |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | two or more | the program's haul-away fee per item multiplied by the lesser of the two counts |
| exactly one | two or more | the program's haul-away fee for one item |
| any other combination | | the haul-away charge on the order |

**Hypothetical cases (fee per item 25.00).** Three such settlements and two old items: 25.00 multiplied by 2, so 50.00. Two settlements and four old items: 50.00. One settlement and three old items: 25.00. Two settlements and one old item: the haul-away charge on the order.
